Power that holds the no-weather speed under the analysed weather
mappings.evidence: Mean of with_weather_watts - no_weather_watts weighted by no_weather_point_time is 12.051 W against the reported 11.957 W. Model CdA median 15.50 m², outside a human range, so these watts describe no body.
